name: Valiant Crowns
description: Valiant Crowns was a street gang based in the Bronx, New York, active during the late 1950s. They were one of the two principal gangs in the 'Crown nation,' a loose alliance of Bronx gangs sharing the Crowns name, alongside the Egyptian Crowns. Smaller affiliated Crown gangs included the Bohemian Crowns, Mafia Crowns, Seven Crowns, Royal Crowns, and Collegiate Crowns. The full alliance was reportedly around 800 members, though contemporary observers questioned that figure. In September 1959, Valiant Crowns member John Guzman was killed by members of the rival Royal Knights.
